background: Dave Neves is a Big Horn County commissioner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. The official commissioners page lists him as a member. He won the November 2022 general election. The Lovell Chronicle reported that he did not file for re-election. Incoming commissioner Mike Laird takes office in January 2027.
